last.verdict: Big beat and higher guidance, but shares ended barely up after an early pop.

reasons.label: Guidance raised again
reasons.text: 2026 adjusted EPS outlook lifted to $7.65-$7.75 from $7.10-$7.25, above the $7.25 consensus.

reasons.label: Record backlog
reasons.text: Backlog hit $340 billion after over $81 billion of new commercial and defense awards.

reasons.label: One-time tariff refund
reasons.text: Adjusted EPS of $2.26 included $0.25 of IEEPA cost recovery, which flatters the quarter.

story: RTX has beaten estimates and raised its 2026 outlook in each of the last few reports. Shares jumped about 8% early after July's report, but fell after April's. October's gain was small.
